metadata.value: stella
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Oh, {player}! Careful, that bench is still warm.

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Productive! Only two small explosions so far, and one of them was on purpose.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: I build things. Magical items, mostly. Relics are just circuits that happen to be very old and very grumpy.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Something that needs all five relics talking to each other. They're not on speaking terms yet.

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: Anything else?

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Stella
nodes.text: See you, {player}. Don't touch anything shiny on the way out.

metadata.value: cinna_cirra
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: {player}! Hello again. I remembered your name. I wrote it down.

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Better, thank you. I've only got lost twice today, which is a personal best.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: I signed up for orientation duty to meet people. It turns out I'm also meant to know things.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Read the signs by the doors. I didn't, for a week. Learn from me.

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Anything else?

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...
About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Cinna Cirra
nodes.text: Bye, {player}! Good luck out there.

metadata.value: orio
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: {player}. Back in the glade? Good, I could use a second opinion.

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Efficient. I automated my morning routine. Now I just need to automate getting up.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: I like puzzles, games and anything that can be made to run by itself. The forest has plenty of all three.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: The mechanism glade. Old runes, older gears. Someone built all of this to be solved.

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Anything else?

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Orio
nodes.text: Until next time, {player}. Mind the moving parts.

metadata.value: katrina
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: {player}. Yes, I remember you. Don't look so surprised.

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Quiet. I prefer quiet. Things are harder to lose when nothing is happening.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: I study memory magic. It's less glamorous than it sounds, and I lose fewer things than people think.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Like reading a letter someone left in a room. Most of it is mundane. Some of it isn't.

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Anything else?

choices.text: About what you asked me to do...

nodes.speaker: Katrina
nodes.text: Goodbye, {player}. Try not to forget anything important.

metadata.value: forest_student
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: {player}! Out on the trail again?

choices.text: Any good spots in the forest?

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Lovely. The lanterns were humming all morning. I think they like the weather.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: I practise out here where it's quiet. The forest doesn't mind if a spell goes a little sideways.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Follow the lanterns to the clearing. It's the best place to practise, and the best place to sit.

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: Anything else?

choices.text: Any good spots in the forest?

nodes.speaker: Grace
nodes.text: See you on the trail, {player}!

metadata.value: prof_voltaire
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Ah, {player}. Here to borrow, to return, or simply to admire the shelves?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Orderly, which is the highest compliment I can pay a day.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: I have kept this Library for longer than some of its books have existed. The rest are older than I am.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Start with the history of the academy. Then the history of the fire. Then the history of the lightning.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Voltaire
nodes.text: Good day, {player}. Mind the due dates.

metadata.value: vex
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: {player}. Inside voice, please.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: It was fine until someone sneezed in the reference section. I'm still recovering.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: I read. Mostly about wards. Circles of protection are fascinating, and they never talk back.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Warding theory, volume three. No, you can't borrow it. I'm on chapter nine.

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Vex
nodes.text: Bye. Quietly.

metadata.value: luna
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: {player}! Oh, hi. Sorry, I was looking up again.

choices.text: What's so special about the stars here?

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Clear skies all day. Tonight should be perfect for stargazing.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: I love the sky. I'd like to study star magic one day. For now, I just look.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: They're brighter here than anywhere else. Some nights it feels like they're looking back.

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Anything else?

choices.text: What's so special about the stars here?

nodes.speaker: Luna
nodes.text: Bye, {player}! Look up sometimes.

metadata.value: juno
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: {player}! Perfect timing. I've got news.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Busy! Three new rumours before lunch, and at least one of them is true.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: I like knowing what's going on. Someone has to, and everyone else is too busy studying.

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Apparently the student who turned up at the gate today looked like they'd fallen out of the sky. Wild, right?

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Juno
nodes.text: Catch you later, {player}! I'll save you the best gossip.

metadata.value: rowan
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Hey, {player}! Still here? Me too. Still waiting on my room.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Long. I've moved my luggage three times and it's still in the lobby.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: First year, same as you. I came for the spellwork and stayed for the dorm food. Allegedly there's dorm food.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Get to know the receptionists. Marigold knows everything, and Thistle can find anything. Eventually.

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Rowan
nodes.text: See you around, {player}!

metadata.value: moss
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: ...Oh. {player}. Hello.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Peaceful. The brook has been loud today, in a nice way.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: I come out here to listen. Campus is wonderful, but it's never quiet.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: The brook, the leaves, the lanterns. If you're very still, they almost sound like they're talking.

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Moss
nodes.text: Bye. Walk softly.

metadata.value: marigold
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Hello again, {player}! How are you settling in?

choices.text: When will my room be ready?

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Busy, but the good kind. New arrivals always mean new faces.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: I've run this reception for years. I know every room, every key, and most of the secrets.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Soon, I promise. We're just sorting today's arrivals. I'll find you the moment it's ready.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: You're very welcome. Sleep well, {player}. Your guide will come and find you tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Anything else?

choices.text: When will my room be ready?

nodes.speaker: Marigold
nodes.text: Take care, {player}!

metadata.value: prof_bann
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Ah, {player}. Finding your feet, I hope?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Full, as every first day is. A headmistress's day is mostly other people's first days.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: I've led Lumenfall for many years. Every student who comes through that gate becomes a little bit my responsibility.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Be curious, and be kind to the other students. Most of what this academy teaches, it teaches through them.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Bann
nodes.text: Off you go, {player}. Make the most of today.

metadata.value: thistle
General conversation once met, to be rewritten.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Oh! {player}. Hello. I was just... looking for something.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: I found the spare keys, lost the spare keys, and found them again. So, fine.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: I help Marigold with the desk. Marigold remembers everything, and I find everything. Eventually.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: The list. The other list. Not the list of lists, that one's fine.

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Thistle
nodes.text: Bye, {player}! If you see a blue folder, it's mine.
